description: Create and prompt-edit Excel reports and text-first team workbooks; verify exact lookups, RAG, WBS and time-off logic, preserve content and add native charts/simple pivots.

requires.runtime: Python >=3.9; operator-selected bundled Node with @oai/artifact-tool (tested bundled runtime 26.909.12148); WORKBOOK_NODE, WORKBOOK_NODE_MODULES, WORKBOOK_PYTHON
requires.model: Explicit caller-selected authoring Ask model/profile; no credentials or default model bundled. Optional visual Ask/model selection is independent and needs image/schema/offline-replay support; no new model-quality claim.
requires.review: Independent semantic and actual-image review remains necessary. Optional selected check covers only added/changed literal strings on LibreOffice saved-workbook pages; formula results, unchanged/style-only content and native Microsoft Excel behavior need separate review.
requires.limits: Macro-free XLSX with bounded ranges. Simple native pivots; existing pivot/cache preservation. No native pivot-layout edits, slicers, Power Query, macros, external connections or unpreservable source features. See EDITING.md.
requires.optional-visual: Default off. Complete WORKBOOK_VISUAL_ASK/MODEL/RECORDS selection; selected Ask also handles offline Record verification. AGENT_RECORD or caller PATH selects Record. For nonempty changed-literal scope also explicitly select absolute WORKBOOK_VISUAL_SOFFICE, WORKBOOK_VISUAL_PDFTOPPM, WORKBOOK_VISUAL_CAGE and WORKBOOK_PYTHON (with host-supplied pypdf). Records outside all action write roots. See VISUAL-CHECK.md and VISUAL-CONTEXT.md. No Weigh dependency.
